# `starhermit:vehicle`

Engine **1.40.0** (host API 1.40), the latest release. Generated from the release's `starhermit.d.ts`; `starhermit types` writes the same file into your game. [All modules](index.md).

```ts
import { … } from "starhermit:vehicle";
```

Vehicle dynamics for racing and driving games (since API\_MINOR 40, `VEHICLE_MINOR`; for a game declaring an older `engine.minor` the import throws a TypeError as the module evaluates). An engine extension: three.js has no vehicle model. Each car is stepped natively on the fixed step (`onFixedUpdate(step) => car.step(step)`), against flat ground or a `Heightfield`, a `Track` naming the surface under each tyre: Pacejka tyres with combined slip, load sensitivity and relaxation length; ten suspension substeps a step with spring, damper, anti-roll bar and bump stop; a rigid body with the gyroscopic term; engine, clutch, sequential gearbox, clutch-pack differential and brakes solved implicitly; drag and downforce; ABS, traction and stability control; and a driver easing keys and sticks into the wheel and pedals (with an automatic gearbox). A run repeats exactly, bit for bit, natively and in browsers. Ported from Solstice (MIT, licenses/LICENSE-solstice).

Fuel: a step costs about 1,800 instructions on flat ground, 5,000 on a heightfield and about 6,500 on a heightfield with a track (a search of a long track's whole lap, off the road, costs more); an autopilot's look ahead about 650. At most 64 vehicles, 16 heightfields (4,194,304 samples in all), 16 tracks and 64 lap timers at once (a RangeError past them; `dispose()` lets one go). A spec's text is at most 64 KiB, a track's 8 MiB.

### VehicleSpecObject

*interface*

A car's numbers: what a `.vehicle` file holds. Lengths are in metres, forces in newtons, torques in newton metres, angles in degrees. The car's origin is on the ground under its middle at rest; it looks along -Z with +X to its right (as a three.js object does). Every field may be left out: the GT racing car's stands (`defaultVehicleSpec()`). A `.vehicle` text has one line a group: `mass 1320`, `inertia PITCH YAW ROLL`, `centre X Y Z`, `body SX SY SZ at X Y Z`, `front KEY=VALUE…`, `rear …`, `tyre …`, `engine …`, `torque RPM NM` (a line a point), `gears R1 R2…`, `final R`, `reverse R`, `gearbox …`, `diff …`, `aero …`, `steering …`, `geometry …`, `assists …` (`#` comments).

```ts
export interface VehicleSpecObject { … }
```

- `mass?: number;`

- `inertia?: Vec3;`

  About its pitch (X), yaw (Y) and roll (Z) axes, kg m².

- `centre?: Vec3;`

  The centre of mass from the origin: right, up, back.

- `body?: { size?: Vec3; at?: Vec3 };`
- `front?: AxleSpec;`
- `rear?: AxleSpec;`

- ```ts
  tyre?: {
      /** Peak friction along and across the tyre. */
      grip?: [number, number];
      /** The slip ratio and slip angle (degrees) where they peak. */
      peak?: [number, number];
      /** The Magic Formula's C (1–2) and E (below 1), along and across. */
      along?: [number, number];
      across?: [number, number];
      load?: number;
      sensitivity?: number;
      relaxation?: number;
    };
  ```

- ```ts
  engine?: {
      idle?: number;
      limit?: number;
      inertia?: number;
      friction?: [number, number];
      /** Full-throttle torque by rpm, rising in rpm: 2 to 64 points. */
      torque?: [number, number][];
    };
  ```

- `gears?: number[];`

  Forward gears, first first, each taller (smaller): 1 to 10.

- `final?: number;`
- `reverse?: number;`
- `gearbox?: { shift?: number; efficiency?: number; clutch?: number };`
- `diff?: { preload?: number; power?: number; coast?: number };`
- `aero?: { drag?: number; downforce?: number; balance?: number };`
- `steering?: { lock?: number; ackermann?: number };`
- `geometry?: { antiDive?: number; antiSquat?: number };`
- `assists?: { abs?: boolean; traction?: boolean; stability?: boolean };`

### Heightfield

*class*

A grid of heights to drive on without a physics world: `columns` samples along +X and `rows` along +Z, `spacing` metres apart, the first at `origin`, row by row (`heights[row * columns + column]`). Each square is two triangles split from its corner nearest the origin to the far one; a mesh drawn with that split is the ground the wheels find. Off the grid there is no ground. `surfaces`, one a sample (an index into `SURFACES`), else `surface` (grass) everywhere. A RangeError for 2 to 4097 samples a side broken, a spacing outside 0.01–1000, heights that are not finite or not one a sample.

```ts
export class Heightfield { … }
```

- ```ts
  constructor(options: {
      columns: number;
      rows: number;
      spacing: number;
      origin?: Vec3Like;
      heights: ArrayLike<number>;
      surfaces?: Uint8Array | ArrayLike<number> | null;
      surface?: Surface;
    });
  ```

- `readonly columns: number;`
- `readonly rows: number;`
- `readonly spacing: number;`
- `readonly origin: Vec3;`
- `heightAt(x: number, z: number): number | null;`
- `sample(x: number, z: number): { height: number; normal: Vec3; surface: Surface } | null;`
- `dispose(): void;`

### Track

*class*

A circuit from its `.track` text: `name NAME`, `sector POINT` (each further sector's first point), and one `p X Y Z LX LY LZ LEFT RIGHT [l=SURFACE:WIDTH,…] [r=…]` a point of the centre line in order round the lap (LX LY LZ the unit way across to the driver's left; LEFT and RIGHT how far the asphalt reaches; `l=`/`r=` the strips beyond it, outwards; grass past the last). 3 to 65,536 points; a mistake is a SyntaxError naming its line.

```ts
export class Track { … }
```

- `constructor(text: string);`
- `readonly name: string;`

- `readonly length: number;`

  The lap's length along the centre line, in metres.

- `readonly sectorStarts: readonly number[];`

  How far round the lap each sector starts, the first at 0.

- `readonly points: number;`

- `locate(x: number, y: number, z: number, hint?: number): TrackPlace;`

  `hint` is a `sample` the point was near (a search of the whole lap without one).

- ```ts
  pointAt(along: number): {
      position: Vec3;
      forward: Vec3;
      left: Vec3;
      quaternion: [number, number, number, number];
    };
  ```

  The centre line `along` metres round the lap (wrapping), the way it runs and the way to its left, and the turn of a car standing there facing round the lap.

- `toText(): string;`
- `dispose(): void;`

### Vehicle

*class*

A car (the GT racing car without a spec), standing still with its engine idling in neutral. A spec with a mistake is a SyntaxError naming its line; an object with a key no spec has, or a value not a finite number (a boolean for `driven` and `assists`), a TypeError.

```ts
export class Vehicle { … }
```

- `constructor(spec?: string | VehicleSpecObject, options?: VehicleOptions);`
- `readonly spec: Required<VehicleSpecObject>;`
- `setGround(ground: Heightfield | { height?: number; surface?: Surface }, track?: Track | null): void;`

- `input(input: DriverInput): void;`

  What the player asks for the steps from now, eased by the driver: steering eases and gives less lock the faster the car goes, follows a slide, pedals ease, and the automatic gearbox changes gear (and finds reverse when the car is held still on the brake).

- `controls(controls: DriverInput): void;`

  The wheel and pedals as they are, past the driver (a NaN is 0).

- `step(seconds: number): void;`

  One fixed step of `seconds` (above 0, at most 0.1; a RangeError otherwise): ten substeps of suspension, tyres, drivetrain, air and body.

- `automatic: boolean;`
- `readonly position: Vec3;`
- `readonly quaternion: [number, number, number, number];`

- `readonly velocity: Vec3;`

  Of the centre of mass, m/s; and the spin, rad/s about the world's axes.

- `readonly spin: Vec3;`
- `readonly speed: number;`
- `readonly rpm: number;`

- `gear: number;`

  Setting it puts the car in that gear at once (-1 to the top gear).

- `readonly telemetry: Telemetry;`

- `wheel(index: number): WheelState;`

  0 front left, 1 front right, 2 rear left, 3 rear right.

- `readonly offTrack: boolean;`

  All four tyres last touched grass or gravel.

- `applyTo(body: Placeable | null, wheels?: readonly (Placeable | null | undefined)[], alpha?: number): void;`

  Sets `body`'s position and quaternion to the car's, `alpha` (0–1, onRender's) of the way from the step before to the last, and each of `wheels` (its children) to its hub's.

- ```ts
  place(
      position: Vec3Like,
      quaternion?: ArrayLike<number> | { x: number; y: number; z: number; w: number },
      velocity?: Vec3Like,
      spin?: Vec3Like,
    ): void;
  ```

  Puts the car there (within a thousand kilometres), turned and moving so (at most 10 km/s), its wheels rolling with it.

- `placeOnTrack(track: Track, along: number, lift?: number): void;`

  At rest on a track's centre line `along` metres round the lap, `lift` (0.05) metres up, facing round the lap, settled.

- `settle(): void;`

  Stops every wheel and idles the engine in neutral, at rest.

- `dispose(): void;`

### LapTimer

*class*

Times laps and sectors of one car round a track. A lap counts only if every sector's line was crossed in order and at least half the lap's length was driven forwards; a lap on which all four wheels left the track is timed and not valid. A jump of more than 40 m between steps is not driving.

```ts
export class LapTimer { … }
```

- `constructor(track: Track);`
- `readonly track: Track;`

- `step(at: Vehicle | Vec3Like, seconds: number, offTrack?: boolean): LapEvent[];`

  Follows the car (or a point) through one step; `offTrack` is the vehicle's own `offTrack` when a vehicle is given (else false).

- `interrupt(): void;`

  The car was put back: the lap being driven no longer counts.

- `readonly count: number;`
- `readonly current: number | null;`
- `readonly last: number | null;`
- `readonly best: number | null;`
- `readonly valid: boolean;`
- `readonly lastValid: boolean;`
- `readonly sector: number;`
- `readonly splits: readonly number[];`
- `readonly bestSplits: readonly (number | null)[];`
- `readonly along: number;`
- `dispose(): void;`

### Autopilot

*class*

A self-driving car, for AI drivers: it steers for the centre line a way ahead (`lookAhead` + `lookAheadPerSpeed` × speed metres) and goes no faster than lets it slow, at `braking` m/s², for each bend coming, taken at `cornering` m/s² (curvature from three points of the line, every 8 m over the next 260 m), and at most `topSpeed` m/s.

```ts
export class Autopilot { … }
```

- ```ts
  constructor(
      track: Track,
      options?: { cornering?: number; braking?: number; topSpeed?: number; lookAhead?: number; lookAheadPerSpeed?: number },
    );
  ```

- `readonly track: Track;`
- `cornering: number;`
- `braking: number;`
- `topSpeed: number;`
- `lookAhead: number;`
- `lookAheadPerSpeed: number;`

- `drive(vehicle: Vehicle): { throttle: number; brake: number; steer: number };`

  Sets the car's input for its next step; what it asked.
